description:
TrailVerse brings national parks exploration into ChatGPT.

Live data for 470+ U.S. national parks, monuments, and historic sites — plus day-by-day trip planning. Tell Trailie you’re a beginner with kids visiting Zion in July, and it can build a pace-matched itinerary using live NPS alerts and weather, with hike limits and family-friendly pacing when you ask. Always confirm safety-critical details on NPS.gov before you go.

Five focused capabilities:

• Plan a trip — Constraint-aware day-by-day itineraries (dates, hike difficulty/distance, pace). Revise the plan in the same chat. Best for NPS parks; also useful for broader U.S. trip ideas.

• Park details — Live weather, alerts, entrance fees, and top activities for NPS sites.

• Compare parks — Side-by-side 2–4 NPS parks with clear highlights.

• Search parks — Find NPS sites by state, activity, or name across the full catalog.

• Find events — Upcoming ranger programs, guided tours, and park-hosted events.

Read tools use the National Park Service API and live weather. Campground and permit inventory are not guaranteed live — confirm on Recreation.gov or NPS before booking. Free to use in ChatGPT. For saved trips, PDF export, and full Trailie history, continue at nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai.

defaultPrompt: Plan a 3-day Shenandoah trip from Oct 15, 2026: easy hikes under 3 miles, photography, one relaxed afternoon.
What's the latest weather, alerts, and conditions at Acadia National Park right now?
Compare Smoky Mountains and Acadia for a fall photography weekend — which fits better?
